newsitem.title: UK: BG gains as Merrill upgrades trading advice.
newsitem.headline: BG gains as Merrill upgrades trading advice.

text.p: Shares in BG Plc gained after Merrill Lynch raised its trading recommendation to "neutral" from "reduce".
The stock rose 7p to 253-1/2p in heavy trade.

Merrill analyst Andrew Wright said the change in view was based on "BG's greater confidence to achieve its regulatory returns from Transco, greater rewards for shareholders following the management's change in attitude after accepting the MMC report, and reduced uncertainty following payment of the windfall tax".
Wright also changed his profit forecasts.
He raised his pre-tax profit estimate for 1997 to 1,141 million stg from 1,084 million and cut 1998 to 773 million from 916 million.
